page: Microsoft Azure L160ias_v5 is an isolated, storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Lasv5 series. Built on the x86_64 architecture with dedicated AMD processors, this instance provides 160 virtual CPUs and 1280.0 GB of system memory. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, it delivers an 8.0 GB memory-per-core ratio across a fully isolated hardware footprint.

A defining attribute of the L160ias_v5 is its integrated local NVMe SSD storage array, which totals 30,718 GB. The machine operates without dedicated GPU hardware and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Its architecture couples high core density and extensive volatile memory directly with local high-throughput solid-state storage, avoiding network storage latency for local data operations.

Given its dedicated hardware isolation, 160 vCPUs, 1.28 TB of memory, and massive 30.7 TB local NVMe capacity, the instance is engineered for demanding I/O-intensive workloads. Appropriate deployments include large distributed databases, high-performance data warehousing, transactional systems, real-time analytics, and big data processing pipelines that require dense local storage accompanied by substantial memory capacity.
